factors.name: None / not applicable
factors.source_document: N/A
factors.assumptions: Leave at zero. Use when a scenario has no transit.

factors.name: Passenger car (avg gasoline)
factors.source_document: GHG Emission Factors Hub, Table 10
factors.assumptions: Per vehicle: calculator multiplies by vehicles, not people. CO2 0.297 + CH4/N2O converted with AR5 GWPs.

factors.name: SUV / pickup / van (light-duty truck)
factors.source_document: GHG Emission Factors Hub, Table 10
factors.assumptions: CO2 0.394 + CH4/N2O converted with AR5 GWPs.

factors.name: Electric vehicle
factors.source_document: GHG Emission Factors Hub, Table 6, eGRID NYUP
factors.assumptions: 0.3 kWh/mile is an assumed EV efficiency. Upstate NY grid is very clean, so this is low.
factors.limitations: Requires verification against actual EV efficiency and grid emissions data.

factors.name: Air - short haul (<300 mi)
factors.source_document: GHG Emission Factors Hub, Table 10
factors.assumptions: Excludes non-CO2 effects (RF multiplier = 1.0).

factors.name: Air - medium haul (300-2300 mi)
factors.source_document: GHG Emission Factors Hub, Table 10
factors.assumptions: Excludes non-CO2 effects (RF multiplier = 1.0). Used for Persona 2.

factors.name: Air - long haul (>2300 mi)
factors.source_document: GHG Emission Factors Hub, Table 10
factors.assumptions: Excludes non-CO2 effects (RF multiplier = 1.0).

factors.name: Intercity rail (Amtrak)
factors.source_document: GHG Emission Factors Hub, Table 10
factors.assumptions: Uses 'Intercity Rail - Other Routes' since Ithaca is not on the Northeast Corridor.

factors.name: Intercity / charter bus (coach)
factors.source_document: GHG Emission Factors Hub, Table 10
factors.assumptions: EPA 'Bus' row.

factors.name: Local transit bus (TCAT)
factors.source_document: GHG Emission Factors Hub, Table 10 / National Transit Database
factors.assumptions: EPA national bus average used as a stand-in for TCAT.
factors.limitations: Replace with TCAT data from the National Transit Database if available.

factors.name: Walk / bike
factors.source_document: N/A
factors.assumptions: Zero direct emissions.
factors.limitations: Not necessarily zero lifecycle emissions in a full lifecycle assessment.

factors.name: Hotel (US average)
factors.source_document: GHG Conversion Factors, 'Hotel stay' sheet
factors.assumptions: ~16.1 kg per room-night for US hotels, taken from a secondary source citing DESNZ.
factors.limitations: Confirm in the DESNZ 'Hotel stay' tab. Replace with upstate NY figure if available.

factors.name: Hotel (green-certified / efficient)
factors.source_organization: Estimate based on Cornell Hotel Sustainability Benchmarking Index
factors.source_document: Derived: ~15% below US average hotel factor
factors.assumptions: Certified/efficient hotels (LEED, Green Seal, Energy Star) typically benchmark 10-20% below the US average per room-night in CHSB-style data; a conservative 15% reduction is applied to the 16.1 kg US average.
factors.limitations: Estimate only. Replace with a CHSB-derived figure for certified properties when available.

factors.name: Full-service restaurant
factors.source_document: Supply Chain GHG Emission Factors v1.3 (NAICS 722511)
factors.assumptions: NAICS 722511, factor with margins. Switched from per-meal to per-dollar so food matches the spend data in the Visitor Profile Study.
factors.limitations: Economic-sector spending proxy, not direct measurement of individual meals.

factors.name: Wineries & breweries
factors.source_document: Supply Chain GHG Emission Factors v1.3 (NAICS 312130)
factors.assumptions: NAICS 312130 (wineries). Breweries are 0.274 (NAICS 312120).
factors.limitations: Note: The spreadsheet combines wineries and breweries at 0.182, but notes breweries should be 0.274. This distinction needs handling in implementation.

factors.limitations: Likely understates, since it covers the store more than the goods.
